buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free

Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Drawing - After award of Contract the Successful Bidder shall submit Detailed Design Drawings for Buyer's approval, within a week of award of contract. Buyer shall, either approve the drawings or w ill provide complete list of modification required in the drawings. Seller shall be required to ensure alteration as per approved Drawings as communicated by Buyer. 2. Certification - The necessary Test Certificate/Report of equipments including pumps should be up loaded during the time of participating in the bid. 3. Other Documents - Bidder should submit copies of GST, PAN and Bank Account details during par ticipation in the bid. 4. Undertaking - Bidder should submit undertaking for acceptance of all Terms & Conditions & Tech nical Specifications stipulated in bid document. 5. Experience of Service Engineers - Bidder should furnish undertaking/declaration mentioning th at the Service Engineers has at least 01 year of relevant experience in this field. 6. IP Address - Bidders are advised that the GeM portal records and displays the IP addresses used by both Buyers and Bidders/Sellers during the bidding process. Bidders are therefore advised to en sure that bids are submitted from secure and inde pendent networks to maintain transparency an d avoid rejection on account of common IP usage. In case multiple bids are submitted using a co mmon IP address, all such bids shall be summarily rejected and excluded from further evaluation. 7. Warranty : The bidder shall be responsible to repair or replace the provided spares, if any defect arises during the period of 01 year from the date of completion of work/service for installation of Fi xed Fire Fighting System. 8. Timely Servicing / rectification of defects : After having been notified of the defects in the pro vided spares, the bidder/seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 20 days t ime limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0. 5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover al l such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG). Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed m ore than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the servic e / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of P BG. 9. Service Support - The bidder must have a functional Shop/Office/Service Centre within the jurisdi ction of Andaman & Nicobar Islands to provide service support during the period of warranty. Firms applying from outside the A&N Islands shall compulsorily submit the complete address, contact nu mber and authorization details of their Service Centre or Authorized Representative located in Sri Vijaya Puram. The bidder shall also submit a valid Andaman & Nicobar Islands Shop and Establish ment Certificate/GST Registration. 10. Earnest Money Deposit - Scanned copy of Earnest Money Deposit for Rs.15,975/- @ 2% of bid value in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt/Bank Gua rantee from a Commercial Bank for safeguard ing the purchase interest in all resp ect of A&N Police Fire and Emergency Services drawn in favour of the “Dy. Superi ntendent of Police (F&ES), Sri Vijaya Puram, A&N Islands”. MSME or NSIC of relat ed category/Start-up will be exempted from EMD. Bidder has to upload scanne d copy/ proof of the

EMD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to 6 / 9the Buyer within 5 days of Bid o pening date. 11. Performance Security : After finalization of the bid, lowest bidder will submit Performance Securi ty deposit i.e. 5% of contract value within 15 days which is valid fo r the period of 60 days beyond the warranty period of the supplied items i.e. for th e period of 14 months. The security deposit sh all also be in the form of Bank Guar antee or Fixed Deposit from a Commercial Bank in an accepta ble form safeguar ding the purchaser’s interest in respect of A&N Fire and Emergency Services dra w n in favour of the Deputy Superintendent of Police (F&ES), A&N Islands. 12. Liquidated Damages (LD) : If the Seller/Service Provider fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/S ervices within the original/re-fixed delivery period(s) specified in the contract, the Buyer will be ent itled to deduct/recover the Liquidated Damages for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure conditions aforesaid, @ 0.5% of the contract value of delayed quantity per week or part of the wee k of delayed period as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contract value of delayed quantity without any controversy/dispute of any sort whatsoever. 13. Bidder shall submit declaration that the Service E ngineers have at least 01 year of relevant experienc e in this field. b) PAN Card Scanned copy of PAN Card c) Bank Detail Scanned copy of Bank Account details. d) GST Certificate Scanned GST Registration Certificate and GST No. of the firm. e) EMD Scanned copy of EMD for Rs.15,975/- (Furnish docu ment for exemption under MSME/STARTUP/NSIC) f) Minimum Average Annual Bidder should submit document evidence for annual Turnover of the bidder turnover of Rs.2 lakh for the last three financial year. (Submit document for exemption under MSME/STARTUP/NSIC) g) Service & Support 1.Bidder should furnish Dedicated/toll Free Telephon e No. for Service Support. 2.The bidder shall also submit a valid Andaman & Ni cobar Islands Shop and Establishment Certificate/ GST Registration. h) Experience The bidder must have experience for 01 year as indi cated in bid document.
